actions.next_implementation: Preserve direct files or byte-identical archived members and record readback hashes. Reconcile new handover artifacts separately from prior conversation completeness.
actions.handover_acceptance: Readback receipt plus coverage exceptions; do not claim unprovided full transcripts or local workstation files were reviewed.

subtasks.title: Refresh latest-version merge matrix
subtasks.implementation: Diff final A03/A04 against recovery.3, SMS R4, storage R3, API r3, presentation.3, release r4, routing/import v1.2 and runner r3. Classify each path as retained, equivalent, merged or deliberately excluded with rationale.
subtasks.acceptance: Updated path-level ledger; no blind whole-tree replacement.

subtasks.title: Resolve shared runtime call-site overlap
subtasks.implementation: Review OperationJournal, NativeRepository, ApiClient/CloudClient, BuriViewModel, workers, stores and installers together. Test stale generation plus uncertain outcome plus storage failure and restored screen in one integrated flow.
subtasks.acceptance: Integrated tests preserve authentication, original IDs and financial-authority boundaries.

subtasks.title: Implement trusted SMS checkpoint service
subtasks.implementation: Implement independently rollback-resistant authenticated durable linearizable CAS with trusted-side transition rules; choose approved offline/unavailable semantics and real ownership authorization.
subtasks.acceptance: Restoring both handset ciphertext and local data cannot rewind trusted state; concurrent writers and outage tests pass.

subtasks.title: Implement encrypted offline intake and blob transactions
subtasks.implementation: Build production CiphertextBlobPort and durable encrypted quarantine before checkpoint-dependent queue admission; retain original SMS while offline and during interrupted admission. Wire migration and worker fences explicitly.
subtasks.acceptance: No SMS evidence loss or intake-cursor advance before durable retention; device power-interruption proof.

subtasks.title: Implement legacy storage adoption and writer cutover
subtasks.implementation: Decode actual product databases and sidecars; freeze old writers, retain complete evidence inventory, explicitly provision valid fresh keys/directories, and persist an irreversible writer handover gate.
subtasks.acceptance: Original IDs, pending operations, tombstones and archived generations survive restart; old writers cannot restart.

subtasks.title: Close storage anti-rollback and capacity policy
subtasks.implementation: Provide trusted monotonic checkpoint for lifecycle history, establish bounded retention/compaction with durable archive readback and resolve unavailable-key/failed deletion policy without automatic reset.
subtasks.acceptance: Valid-suffix truncation detected or safely blocked; approved retention and measured storage exhaustion behavior.

subtasks.title: Wire recovery lifecycle scheduling deliberately
subtasks.implementation: Choose lifecycle owner for opt-in read-only retry; use monotonic clock, shared namespace lock and cancellation. Decide whether durable/global rate limiting is needed. Qualify non-returning transport and restart without new mutation.
subtasks.acceptance: Manual and scheduled GET recovery preserve original command; five-read local policy is not misrepresented as global durable limit.

subtasks.title: Qualify actual HTTP framing and strict-version rollout
subtasks.implementation: Exercise real platform/proxy headers, encoding, body deadlines, cleanup and cancellation. Coordinate strict client/server contract rollout; test rejected success responses as uncertain outcomes.
subtasks.acceptance: No malformed acknowledgement admitted; compatible versions and actual timeout behavior measured.

subtasks.title: Accept bounded positional restoration semantics
subtasks.implementation: Confirm 16-page/2,000-row automatic restoration limits and changed-dataset behavior. Test busy observers, real list headers, process recreation, IME and localized fallback messages.
subtasks.acceptance: Product accepts positional rather than guaranteed same-record restoration; installed accessibility/journeys pass.

subtasks.title: Commission independent signing/provenance trust
subtasks.implementation: Select protected real producer identities and policies outside candidate evidence; onboard signing, key custody, roles, threshold and revocation. Test r4 against final merged sources, not historical baselines.
subtasks.acceptance: Independently authenticated evidence accepted; missing/revoked/wrong-role signatures rejected.

subtasks.title: Triage historical credential-like findings
subtasks.implementation: Review the 33 files flagged on release-r4 historical input trees by location and type without printing values; determine genuine, synthetic or superseded. Rotate genuine exposed credentials and rescan final source/dependencies.
subtasks.acceptance: Every finding disposition evidenced; no assumption that 33 findings are 33 current leaked secrets.

subtasks.title: Close exact missing-executor inventory
subtasks.implementation: Reconcile A03.3 and unified-r3 plans; obtain missing exact packages/toolchains; bind any new dependency overlay and browser reference. Keep PGlite and real PostgreSQL results separate.
subtasks.acceptance: All required current plan entries executed or explicitly excluded by documented scope decision; no inherited pass.

subtasks.title: Execute MoU and governance particulars
subtasks.implementation: Complete legal identities, mandates, delegation and Schedule 1 decision register; locate or obtain executed counterpart and evidence of required function-specific approvals.
subtasks.acceptance: Authorised signatures and applicable conditions recorded; final document title alone is not execution.

subtasks.title: Verify actual sandbox and regulatory authority
subtasks.implementation: Inspect actual approval letters, permitted institution/product/population/term, amendments and reporting obligations. Verify continuation/transition dates and any outsourcing classification with qualified counsel.
subtasks.acceptance: Written scope permits intended pilot; no inference from public framework, publicity or an application/report.

subtasks.title: Approve one product terms and disclosure matrix
subtasks.implementation: Reconcile RWF 1,000 contribution minimum, voluntary frequency, approved rates, pledged-only uplift, exit rules, hardship exceptions, charges and complaints across app, contracts, cards and reporting.
subtasks.acceptance: BSM-approved bilingual version; no contradiction between any-amount claims, minimums or conditional credit promises.

subtasks.title: Sign savings activation acceptance
subtasks.implementation: Complete Schedule 7 savings criteria: product/account authority, BSM authoritative ledger, reconciliation/value dates, disclosures, privacy, support and full end-to-end tests.
subtasks.acceptance: Dated savings activation certificate with attached evidence; source/test-tool completion is not sufficient.

subtasks.title: Keep credit separately gated
subtasks.implementation: Approve tariff, affordability, capacity, individual loan/pledge/debit mandates, security perfection/release/enforcement and any guarantee/insurance before enabling credit.
subtasks.acceptance: Separate credit acceptance; savings can be evaluated without representing credit as active.

subtasks.title: Approve privacy, retention and hosting controls
subtasks.implementation: Document controller/processor responsibilities, DPIA/data flow, lawful access, hosting/transfers, retention, incident procedures and staff use restrictions. Keep financial-retention rules distinct from personal-app deletion.
subtasks.acceptance: Approved policies and tested technical enforcement; no uncontrolled customer SMS in general AI accounts.

subtasks.title: Fund and staff the operating model
subtasks.implementation: Name operational, support, incident, reconciliation and backup owners; approve IKANISA-funded implementation/outreach budget and BSM financial responsibilities. Do not assume an unsigned interparty fee model.
subtasks.acceptance: Funded budget, staffing/training, signed operating responsibility and contact matrix.

subtasks.title: Gate outreach and reporting programme
subtasks.implementation: Confirm four centres, local permissions, trained teams, approved printed cards, radio/influencer bookings and programme budget. Distinguish Jan 1,000-member ambition from authorised caps and actual results. Gate collection at outreach events on readiness.
subtasks.acceptance: Verified venues/dates/permissions; measured report replaces targets; continuity plan before source-stated 5 February 2027 milestone subject to actual approval.

phases.title: Authority, scope and ownership
phases.exit_evidence: Named accountable owners; target/environment decisions; approved operating and product scope. Engineering can proceed safely without live funds.
phases.hold: No production activation or financial commissioning inferred.

phases.title: One complete source and reproducible local evidence
phases.exit_evidence: All latest workstreams dispositioned; exact pins/manifests; mandatory local checks completed on same source.
phases.hold: Do not overwrite unknown receiver edits or use old evidence for new source.

phases.title: Real repository, storage and authority integration
phases.exit_evidence: Protected receiving commit; real migration/auth/RLS rehearsal; production adapters and preserved-state cutover.
phases.hold: No service-role client shortcut, silent empty-store recreation or new ID for uncertainty.

phases.title: Canonical services, Admin and preview end-to-end
phases.exit_evidence: Actual hosted route/auth/processor/Admin and PostgreSQL reconciliation evidence.
phases.hold: Stub success is not hosted acceptance; captured SMS is not credited savings.

phases.title: Native, physical reliability and independent assurance
phases.exit_evidence: Pinned builds, APK inspection, real device/SIM/storage/accessibility tests, security and signed provenance.
phases.hold: Host JVM and syntax checks cannot replace Android instrumentation.

phases.title: Operational commissioning and savings acceptance
phases.exit_evidence: Custody, on-call, monitoring, restore/stop rehearsals and signed savings activation.
phases.hold: Outreach date is not go-live authority.

phases.title: Bounded authorised pilot
phases.actions: A24; B05 only for credit activation
phases.exit_evidence: Consented pilot in approved limits; daily reconciliation, complaints and stop controls evidenced.
phases.hold: Credit remains disabled without its separate acceptance.

phases.title: Attributable release and receiving closure
phases.dependencies: P6 and all mandatory gate evidence
phases.exit_evidence: One signed release with exact commit/APK/deployment/evidence identities and accountable acceptance.
phases.hold: No automatic promotion on valid-but-blocked evidence.
